title: On the Origin of Species
author: Charles Darwin
current_text: On the Origin of Species was banned from Trinity College, Cambridge, England, in 1859.

sources.quote:
Charles Darwin 
The Origin of Species 
Banned from Trinity College, Cambridge, England in 1859. In 1925 the state of Tennessee passed a law prohibiting teachers from teaching the theory of evolution in state supported schools.

ban_rows.note: Banned by Nazi regime for conflicting with ideological views on race and creation.
